doc: FBL 0.11, section 4.9 (Writing, an absent part), FR-006 and FR-007: positional arguments written where they are absent, from the C4 module's C4AppendedArgument cases, written here. On 'container "Web" // c' the technology is written right after the last present argument and before the comment, the empty description padded before it; on 'softwareSystem "S" {' a set and a written part leave the block's opening and its bytes; on 'container "API" ""' the technology follows the empty description, which is not padded again, and clearing it again leaves the empty description before it.

steps.doc: The technology is one insert-key after "Web" and before the trailing comment, with the absent description padded as "" (create with pad).
Undo puts back the bytes the edit replaced.
A description written on an entry that opens a block goes after its name and before ' {', and no byte of the block changes.
Undo puts back the bytes the edit replaced.
A set of a present argument of an entry that opens a block replaces that argument only, written between the quotes its slot's requote gives (FBL 0.15 6.3, A string).
Undo puts back the bytes the edit replaced.
The empty description is present, so the technology follows it and nothing is padded.
Clearing the technology, the last positional argument, writes it empty (empty: keep) and leaves the empty description before it as it is.
Undo puts back the bytes the edit replaced.
